tomcat: Tomcat Agent CLI — a pluggable AI agent runtime
tomcat.long: Tomcat is a pluggable AI agent runtime powered by rquickjs. Use tomcat claw for a global conversation or tomcat code for a project-scoped conversation.
tomcat.init: Initialize configuration, model credentials and security settings
tomcat.doctor: Check the environment, QuickJS resources and configuration
tomcat.config.get: Read a configuration key, or print the complete configuration
tomcat.config.get.key: Configuration path, such as log.level or llm.default_model
tomcat.config.set: Update and validate a configuration key
tomcat.config.set.key: Configuration path, such as log.level or ui.language
tomcat.config.edit: Open the configuration in EDITOR (defaults to vi/notepad)
tomcat.session: List, create, switch, delete, archive or search sessions
tomcat.plugin.load.path: Plugin directory or plugin.json manifest path
tomcat.plugin.build.path: Plugin directory or plugin.json manifest path
tomcat.audit: List, inspect or export audit records
tomcat.skill.reload: Rescan Skill directories and show discovery results
tomcat.model: Manage models, API keys and the default model
tomcat.model.list: List available models and API key status
tomcat.model.add: Add or replace a user model
tomcat.model.add.api: Protocol family: openai, openai-responses or anthropic-messages
tomcat.model.add.provider: Provider name (determines the default API key environment variable)
tomcat.model.add.model_name: Upstream model name (defaults to the model ID)
tomcat.model.add.api_key_env: API key environment variable (defaults based on provider)
tomcat.model.add.web_search: Whether the model supports web search
tomcat.model.add.context_window_options: Allowed context window size (repeatable; must include --context-window)
tomcat.model.add.thinking_format: Thinking format, such as deepseek, doubao or anthropic
tomcat.model.remove: Remove a user model (built-in models cannot be removed)
tomcat.model.key.set: Store an API key for a provider or environment variable
tomcat.model.key.list: List API key slots required by current models
tomcat.install: Install a package, plugin or Skill
tomcat.install.scope_root: Explicit project root for scope installation
tomcat.install.force: Allow replacing resources with the same name in this scope
tomcat.uninstall: Uninstall a package and its resources from a scope
tomcat.uninstall.scope_root: Explicit project root for scope uninstallation
tomcat.packages.visibility: Filter by scope (defaults to current project, agent and global)
tomcat.packages.scope_root: Explicit project root for the scope view
tomcat.workspace: Add, list or remove workspace directories
tomcat.pathrules.add.path: Target path (supports ~; nonexistent paths are accepted with a warning)
tomcat.pathrules.list: List effective built-in, user and session path rules
tomcat.claw: Start a global conversation (not bound to the working directory)
tomcat.claw.resume: Resume the last session (the default behavior)
tomcat.code.resume: Resume the last session (the default behavior)
tomcat.serve: Expose the multi-session Agent Server to IDEs over stdio
tomcat.serve.print_schema: Export the Serve protocol schema and exit
tomcat.chat.resume: Resume the last session (the default behavior)
